criteria.statement: Generic worker placement honors pinned_worker by making only the pinned pubkey eligible.
Generic preview/ranking shows requirement incompatibility reasons for the pinned worker and pin mismatch reasons for other workers.
Generic and ML placement support label_selector and rollout.to_labels as hard constraints for new placements.
ML placement honors pinned_worker and preview includes incompatibility reasons when the pinned worker fails runtime or resource requirements.
worker-policy.apply.request is accepted through the controlplane, validates idempotency/correlation, updates environment runtime_config.worker_policy, and publishes status/result/read-model events.
workload.pin.request is accepted through the controlplane, validates idempotency/correlation and worker existence, and updates the target environment or ML inference endpoint placement policy.
